class.name: InventoryPickupSource
class.brief_description: Game-owned authority policy for a world pickup.

method.name: _register_stores
method.description: Optionally register pickup source stores on the fresh authority coordinator. Called once for each prospective authority match. Return [code]OK[/code] when ready or a Godot [enum Error] on failure.

method.name: _resolve_pickup
method.description: Read committed authority state, check eligibility for the trusted player, and return an [InventoryPickup] that describes the item and the source edit. Return [code]null[/code] to reject. Do not publish changes during resolution.
